page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines of type from top to bottom, with a printer's ornament band above the first line and a small vignette woodcut between the dedication and the author's name, then the printer's imprint and date at the foot.

main_text.l: Pastori vigilantissimo, & in Academia Genevensi Philosophiae Professori

l.i: Hasce Theses Philosophicas in perpetuum debitae

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side is left out: the large reversed "THESES", "PHILOSOPHICA", "IOANNES ROBERTUS CHOVETUS Genevensis" and the mirrored imprint lines. Printer's ornament band above the first line and a small woodcut vignette between the "Praeceptoribus" and "Hasce" lines are not text. The date reads CIↃ. IↃC. LXII., transcribed as MDCLXII. (1662); the final C and X are slightly blurred, so the year is a reading to check. A faint mark at the very foot (perhaps a gathering or format mark, "4º" or similar) is too indistinct to read and is not transcribed. The Greek word τεκμήριον is copied as printed.
